Watched 29 Dec 2025 7

Lovely to be a part of this world again and spend some time (quite a lot) with these characters we know. Some of them are being fleshed out a bit more, which is nice. 

I just wish they would put as much effort in the story as they do in the looks. This is just Way of Water 2.0, amped up the spectacle and added a few new characters. And it annoys me that almost all humans are still caricatures.…
